annotations.text:
/ — Tuesday, not picked, report open

Review problem 1; ADR-097 Home card; owner decision C (Compete)

A short header, then the 'now' stack ordered by deadline: picking (locks Wed 19:55), then the report (closes Thu). Coins tile gone (the pill shows it). Compete carries 'Pick' until the five are saved.

/ — Wednesday 20:18, your match live

Review problem 1; MM 2.0 'matches unfold chance by chance'

During the evening the live card leads Home: your match's score, the latest chance in team colours, and one button. Home doesn't poll: it shows the match as it stood when the page loaded, and the button goes to the live page.

/LEADERBOARD — Standings under Compete

Owner decision C: Leaderboard becomes Compete › Standings; /leaderboard keeps its URL

Section tabs Midweek · Standings · Players on all three. The heading says Standings, like the section tab. The table itself is today's, unchanged.

/MESSAGES — linked rows; a result for every entrant

Review problem 3; owner answer 3 (every entrant gets a result message, amends ADR-096)

Each message is one link to its subject; opening it marks it read. Unread rows carry a filled dot AND the word New. The Midweek result now reaches members who won nothing too.

/MIDWEEK — open, nothing picked

KB-029; review problem 4; §44.2 auto squads

The lock time and countdown sit together on one line (KB-029); the seal moved to the bracket. Slots come first. The save bar is inline and states why it's disabled. Phones get a compact list with an archetype filter; from lg, the LiveCard grid.

/MIDWEEK — three picked, choosing slot 4, unsaved

KB-028, KB-029; ADR-099 frozen archetypes

Wout Y. changed archetype after the week opened: "Goalkeeper this week, Speedster from next" now shows in the slot row, the phone list, the desktop team sheet and on the card face in the grid (LiveCard badge). With unsaved changes the save bar becomes sticky above the tab bar.

/MIDWEEK — saved, no earlier week

KB-029: the empty save bar

Saved with no last week to load: the bar shows the saved time and one secondary action, with no empty column. Compete drops its Pick badge.

/MIDWEEK — 19:57, the draw is out

MM 2.0: the bracket and every five are public from the lock; numbers from round 1

Sanne has a bye, so her first match is round 2 at 20:15 against the winner of Mila v Eline: both possible opponents' fives are shown. Form, pick boost and chances appear at 20:00, so the fives carry archetype, tier and OVR only.

/MIDWEEK — 20:18, your match live

MM 2.0: own match chance by chance; others at full time; whose chance

Your match leads: the live scoreboard and the latest chance, then the link to the full match. This round's other matches say In play until their full time, never a score. No per-match full-time estimate: a shoot-out ends later, so a time would give a draw away.

/MIDWEEK — 20:41, knocked out in the quarter-finals

MM 2.0: something to follow after being knocked out (placeholder); coins after the final

Your result folds into 'Your night'. The follow-up option is undecided, so its slot is a marked placeholder. The final is the thing to come back for.

/MIDWEEK — 21:05, the final in a shoot-out

MM 2.0: the final live for everyone; a kick every 5 s; champion after the end

The final takes the place of 'your match' for everyone. Kicks land in the tally every 5 seconds; dashed rings are kicks still to come in the first five. Nobody is named champion and nothing is paid until the last kick.

/MIDWEEK — 21:08, after the final

MM 2.0: post-tournament ratings and a shareable result (placeholders); D4 champion lead

The champion hero as approved, with your night under it. Ratings and the share image are marked placeholders until decided. The fairness seal and seed live here and on the bracket.

/MIDWEEK/2026-10-05/MATCH/[ID] — your match, live at 20:18

Whose chance (owner, 30 Sep and 1 Oct): lanes, blue and red names; no chance counter

Both sides field Iris W.: on screen each is just 'Iris W.', blue for Sanne's and red for Eline's; screen readers hear whose. No headline or facts until full time (they give the result away), and no goals or assists in the Why until then either.

/MIDWEEK/2026-10-05/MATCH/[ID] — a match you're not in, before full time

MM 2.0: every match unfolds at the same pace; others show at full time

Line-ups and the chances before kick-off, nothing that moves. The page says plainly why it isn't live.

/MIDWEEK/2026-10-05/MATCH/[ID] — the same match after full time

§44.10 report; the simpler Why (owner, 1 and 2 Oct)

The full report. Olaf G. and Kees R. play on both sides here, told apart by colour alone on screen. The Why list is shown with 'Show every factor' opened, to show what it reveals; closed, each card is one compact row: its Power in a pill coloured by strength (green strong to orange weak), the name, and a bar against 1.00. The five factors (Rating, Form, Pick, Fitness, Day) each explain themselves on hover, tap or focus; the first card's Form is shown hovered. Power is this match's: the week's power times the Day roll.

/MIDWEEK/2026-10-05/MATCH/[ID] — the final, live in the shoot-out

MM 2.0: the final live for everyone; 5 s per kick

Regulation's chances stay above; the tally grows in place, so the page doesn't scroll as kicks land. The last kick is read out (aria-live polite).

/MIDWEEK/2026-10-05 — 19:57, the draw

MM 2.0: the bracket is public from the lock; review problem 6

Jump links to your match and each round. Round 1 shows kick-off times; round 2 names who is waiting, or 'Winner of …'. From lg, the tree as shipped (KB-031) with kick-off times in its boxes. Names are neutral: team colours only on a match page.

/MIDWEEK/2026-10-05 — 20:18, round 2 in play

MM 2.0: nobody's bracket gets ahead

Round 1 at full time; round 2 in play (your match Live, the others In play with no score); later rounds wait as 'Winner, …'. The tree from lg.

/MIDWEEK/PAST — every past week

Review problem 2 (no archive); old HANDOFF open question 8

One row per week: champion, field, your finish, or why it didn't run. Each opens that week's bracket.
